# Incident Report: Orders-API Inventory Dependency Errors

## Summary
At 03:12 UTC, `orders-api` reported inventory dependency errors (47% error rate) due to failing connections to `inventory-api`.

## Root Cause
`dns_resolution_failure`: An infrastructure change at 02:48:00Z migrated `inventory-api` to the `fulfilment` namespace and retired the old DNS name (`inventory-api.default.svc`), while `orders-api` continued trying to reach the old endpoint.

## Proposed Remediation
Roll back the infra/deploy change or update orders-api configuration. Using `rollback_deploy` on orders-api / inventory migration.
